items.headline: SentinelOne announced first-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results and scheduled a conference call after market close on May 28, 2026.
SentinelOne presented at the Bank of America Global Technology Conference on June 2, 2026.
SentinelOne's Singularity Platform became available through AWS Security Hub Extended, expanding console-native AI-powered endpoint and cloud workload protection for AWS customers.
